## 11. QUERY THIS DATABASE

The structured JSON companion lives at:
```
~/clawd/_TABS/_inventory/MEOK_LABS_2026-06-15/KNOWLEDGE_BASE/knowledge_database.json
```

Query examples:
```bash
# Find all Defense AI OS repos
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('knowledge_database.json')); print([r['name'] for r in d['repos'] if r['category']=='Defense AI OS'])"

# List all sovereign AI models
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('knowledge_database.json')); print(d['models'])"

# All products in tier 1
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('knowledge_database.json')); print([p for p in d['products'] if p.get('tier')==1])"
```
